integrity: The graph is reconstructed from the projective points and lines of a three-dimensional prime-field vector space. Degree separation forces type preservation, and projective stabilizers give exact lower bounds and the complete list of minimum pointwise bases. The packaged verifier enumerates every PGL action for p=2 and p=3 and exhausts all candidate subsets at the minimum thresholds.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the subgroup-intersection graph on proper nontrivial subgroups of \(C_p^3\).
Rank greater than three is not covered.
The automorphism-group identification is treated as prior background; originality is claimed for the determining number, complete minimum-base classification, and exact count.
title: Minimum determining sets in subgroup-intersection graphs of \(C_p^3\)
